verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

segments.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

verses.text: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),

segments.text: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),

segments.text: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

verses.text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.

segments.text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.

verses.text: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

segments.text: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

verses.text: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

verses.text: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

verses.text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.

segments.text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.

verses.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

segments.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

verses.text: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

segments.text: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

verses.text: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.

verses.text: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

segments.text: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

verses.text: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
